description:
About the company
 Our client is a software company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Lead the creation of a measurement approach for an AI system that carries out technical design work. Draw on both hands-on engineering judgment and evaluation know-how, and collaborate with domain experts and other teams to convert findings into clear improvement priorities.
 What you'll do
 - Establish a new assessment framework that defines quality for design work where several answers can be valid.
 - Collaborate with domain experts, external users and internal teams to see how seasoned engineers operate and where the system struggles.
 - Reproduce realistic design tasks and typical failure cases in repeatable test setups that developers can run again.
 - Create and tune automated graders alongside human review processes, and confirm that the graders agree with expert opinion.
 - Convert assessment results into a ranked list of improvements to the system's reasoning.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - About five or more years of professional experience in hardware engineering, AI, or a blend of both, with depth in one and practical familiarity with the other.
 - Substantial hands-on background assessing AI systems, including authoring test tasks, building automated graders and benchmarking them against human review.
 - Solid grasp of how autonomous, agent-style AI systems behave.
 - Grounding in a hardware engineering field, enough to tell sound design from weak design.
 - Comfort working directly with external users, specialists, partners and technical colleagues across functions.
 - Self-assurance to guide work among many stakeholders in a role with high ownership.
 - Based in the US or Canada, and able to travel to an office for one week every 6 weeks.
 Bonus points
 - Prior time at a robotics or physical AI company.
 - Experience building things from zero in an early-stage startup.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 200,000 to 300,000 per year
 - Equity
 Location and work model
 - Remote (US or Canada)
 - Full-time
